```{r}
library(tidyverse)

artbench_styles <- read_csv("data/artbench_twigma_styles.csv")
total_physical <- sum(artbench_styles$artbench_physical_art)
```

## Physical Art Representation Across Historical Styles

In the **ArtBench-10 / AI-ArtBench** dataset, **`r scales::comma(total_physical)` human-made physical artworks** are used as the foundational benchmark for traditional art. To ensure every artistic movement is equally represented without bias toward a single era, the dataset curates exactly **6,000 physical artworks** in each of **10 historical styles** from public museum and gallery archives (WikiArt, Ukiyo-e.org, and Surrealism.website).

By contrast, AI-ArtBench pairs those **6,000 physical artworks per style** against **12,500 AI-generated artworks per style**—more than double the physical count in every category.

```{r}
#| label: fig-physical-usage
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

artbench_styles |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(artbench_physical_art, artbench_ai_art),
    names_to = "art_type",
    values_to = "artwork_count"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    art_type = if_else(
      art_type == "artbench_physical_art",
      "Physical Art (Human-Made)",
      "AI-Generated Art"
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(style, artwork_count), y = artwork_count, fill = art_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Physical Art (Human-Made)" = "#2b5c8f",
      "AI-Generated Art" = "#d95f02"
    ),
    name = "Category"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Physical Art Used per Historical Style (vs. AI Benchmark)",
    subtitle = "6,000 curated human-made artworks in each of 10 styles (60,000 total physical artworks)",
    x = "Historical Art Style",
    y = "Number of Artworks",
    caption = "Source: ArtBench-10 / AI-ArtBench (Kaggle)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12)
```
